what: Python loader from the campaign that typosquatted OpenAI's Privacy Filter as Open-OSS/privacy-filter: it runs decoy code, then fetches a command from jsonkeeper.com and runs it with PowerShell. The report lists this hash among its file hashes without naming the repository that held it; it names SF-D-2026-0006 as the copy in the anthfu repositories.

evidence.basis: HiddenLayer prints this SHA-256 for loader.py in the report's indicators of compromise and analyses the loader as stage 2 of the attack chain.

source.title: Malware Found in Trending Hugging Face Repository "Open-OSS/privacy-filter"
